nodes.label: llama.cpp 1.0
nodes.rationale: Brings LLMs from data center to laptop: local data, offline, no per-token billing.

nodes.label: invest/ Domain
nodes.rationale: daily/ is the first write location; tickers/ and themes/ point back to daily.

nodes.label: StateBridge (hidden-state agent messaging)
nodes.rationale: Last-layer hidden states carry confidence and discarded alternatives that tokens lose; rotate+rescale 64 states and blend 70/30 with nearest embeddings, no training needed.

nodes.label: Token Tax (Tokenizer Language Bias)
nodes.rationale: Low-resource languages get split into more tokens, so the same content costs more, runs slower and often has lower quality.

nodes.label: Verifiable vs Unverifiable Tasks
nodes.rationale: Andrew Ng: AI excels at verifiable tasks but is weaker at judgement-heavy unverifiable ones, so humans still have work.

nodes.label: Append-Only tickers/themes Files
nodes.rationale: Only append over time, newest at bottom, never edit old lines; each line links to that day's daily note.

nodes.label: Domain-Based Repo Structure
nodes.rationale: Shared parts at root, each domain keeps its own folder organized by its purpose; no domain folders at repo root.

nodes.label: Full-Path Wikilink Convention
nodes.rationale: Many files share date-based names, so wikilinks use the full repo-relative path without .md.

nodes.label: TCBS Recommendation Attribution Convention
nodes.rationale: Recommendations always cite source and date and are kept separate from own decisions.

nodes.label: Antigravity Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Unlike multi-agent: one agent, one context window, only the backing model switches.

nodes.label: Dreamer Agent
nodes.rationale: Sonnet subagent restricted to Skill+Bash and exactly two Bash calls (read_today.sh, then one dream.py heredoc); never retries on exit 1 to keep the run deterministic and cheap.

nodes.label: Dream Skill
nodes.rationale: Consolidates log/ bullets into notes/ and index.md like memory consolidation during sleep.

nodes.label: Measure Cost Per Task, Not Per Token
nodes.norm_label: measure cost per task, not per token
nodes.rationale: Hydrogen-xhigh produced 304M output tokens vs Carbon 205M; cheap unit price does not mean fewer total tokens.

nodes.label: Planner-Executor Model Routing
nodes.rationale: Strong expensive model plans, fast cheap model executes and escalates on failure; near strong-model quality at lower cost and time.

nodes.label: Vietnamese Token Cost Experiment
nodes.rationale: Vietnamese is Latin-script but diacritic-heavy; write system prompts in English, output in Vietnamese; factor tokenizer efficiency into model cost.
